During the [[Sedri civil war]], [[Karak's renegades]] '''raided''' the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fitsay]] with the intention of stealing a piece of the [[Golden Sun coral]]. The renegades were opposed by the [[warrior monk]]s with assistance from a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]]. While the renegades were driven off, one renegade did manage to steal a piece of coral and escape with it.<ref name="BGS" />
